main_measure.name: mean short-side next-day excess return

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and correlation > 0) confirms; t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: correlation forecast vs next-day excess return

decided_by: Mean short-side excess return above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive forecast/excess-return correlation.
reading: Agreement counts active bars whose situation can be computed inside the window (up day, close above mid-range, recorded or price-rebuilt compression below 0) and short; the 30 independent case days minimum is applied as 'not observable'; the t clusters deviations by UTC day with a D/(D-1) correction; the supporting correlation is Pearson between the forecast and the raw (unsigned) next-day excess return.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.009262 on the check folds against +0.01381 on every fold
